The '''Teagan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Teagan]]. It was located a short distance from the [[Listehol system/Legends|Listehol system]], just off the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] hyperlanes.<ref name="DitW" />
